svg.title: Module 11 cheat sheet
svg.desc: Template, target mask, packing, compute, data, reasoning, tools, LoRA, and failure modes.

g.text: the template = the contract (Llama-3 · ChatML · Harmony channels · think tags) · labels = −100 outside assistant
37.5% supervised (21/56) · the reply EOT is a target · FFD: 24 → 5 rows
CSFT = 3.5·10¹⁹ — 20,833× below the declared pretraining scenario
24.3 h is arithmetic; measure realized utilization
schedule, warmup, and clipping require task-specific tuning
general dialogue · reasoning demonstrations · tool trajectories
LIMA: quality and diversity matter more than mechanical scale
synthetics: Self-Instruct → Evol-Instruct → Magpie (the empty template)
best-of-N: coverage grows while yield per generation falls
traces of 5–30K tokens · packing is critical · loss on all
R1-Distill: author-reported results depend on protocol
s1-like scenario: one pass = 1.73·10¹⁸ FLOP = 9 minutes
SFT demonstrates behavior; RL optimizes against reward (M12)
call → environment observation → next action or answer
teaches: schema · selection · observation handling · completion
evaluate on target schemas and multi-turn tasks

svg.text: ΔW = (α/r)·B·A atop a frozen W · the sheet: 13.63M = 0.17% of the base · states 119.7 GiB → 208 MiB (×589)
QLoRA floor: 3.97 GiB before activations · evaluate DoRA/rsLoRA/PiSSA separately;
full FT supports deep shifts; adapters change memory accounting but still require comparison
a foreign template is a silent catastrophe · an <|eot_id|> left out of the target — the model never stops · packing without isolation —
cross-example attention leakage · data quality matters · mask analysis only deliberately
the full version is lecture §20; teaching values reproduced by course verification code
